epics.description:
Sprint 0. Docker Compose for all local dependencies.

Reference: 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md
Sprint 0. Shared config, logger, errors, jwt, contracts, testing packages.
Sprint 0. Scaffold all KinVue microservices with health/metrics.
Sprint 1. Auth PostgreSQL schema and migrations.
Sprint 1. MongoDB users and friendships schema.
Sprint 1. Registration Saga, login, refresh, logout, JWKS.
Sprint 1. Profiles, search, friendships, outbox events.
Sprint 2. HTTP edge, JWT validation, routing, rate limits.
Sprint 2. Vite React shell, API client, auth state, routing.
Sprint 2. Register and login pages with E2E tests.
Sprint 2. Profile, user search, friend requests, friends list.
Sprint 3. Movie PostgreSQL schema.
Sprint 3. Catalog, search, watchlist, Meilisearch indexing.
Sprint 3. Admin movies, search, detail, watchlist pages.
Sprint 4. Room create, invite, permissions, close.
Sprint 4. WS handshake, access checks, heartbeat, presence.
Sprint 4. Play/pause/seek, Redis Pub/Sub, cross-instance sync.
Sprint 4. Ephemeral chat and reactions over WebSocket.
Sprint 4. Watch room UI, HLS player, chat, E2E tests.
Sprint 5. RabbitMQ consumer, dedup, in-app notifications.
Sprint 5. Presigned multipart upload to MinIO/S3.
Sprint 5. FFmpeg HLS transcoding pipeline.
Sprint 5. Signed URL media access and player integration.
Sprint 6. Schedule future watch sessions.
Sprint 6. Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards.
Sprint 6. Validation, CORS, security tests, runbooks.
Sprint 6. GitHub Actions CI pipeline.
Sprint 7. E2E, failure, and load tests.
Sprint 7. Production deployment within budget.
Sprint 7. Docs update and v0.1.0-mvp release.

issues.summary: Initialize git repo, add .gitignore, commit docs pack
issues.acceptance: Git repo initialized on main branch. Docs pack committed.

issues.summary: Bootstrap pnpm + Turbo monorepo with root scripts
issues.acceptance: pnpm install succeeds. pnpm build runs. Workspace includes apps/*, packages/*, tests/*.

issues.summary: Add strict root TypeScript + Prettier config
issues.acceptance: tsconfig.base.json strict mode. Prettier configured.

issues.summary: Create target folder structure (apps/, packages/, infra/, tests/, scripts/, docs/)
issues.acceptance: All top-level folders exist per implementation plan.

issues.summary: Create infra/docker-compose.yml with Auth PostgreSQL (5433) and Movie PostgreSQL (5434)
issues.acceptance: Both postgres services start and accept connections.

issues.summary: Add MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Meilisearch, MinIO to Docker Compose
issues.acceptance: pnpm infra:up starts all containers. RabbitMQ UI at :15672. MinIO at :9001. Meilisearch /health OK.

issues.summary: Add MinIO bucket init service for kinvue-media
issues.acceptance: kinvue-media bucket created on startup.

issues.summary: Add Prometheus + Grafana to Docker Compose
issues.acceptance: Prometheus :9090 and Grafana :3001 reachable.

issues.summary: Create .env.example with all required env vars and document port map
issues.acceptance: .env.example contains all vars from implementation plan.

issues.summary: Verify all infra containers healthy
issues.acceptance: docker compose ps shows all healthy. Manual UI checks pass.

issues.summary: Create packages/config with Zod-validated env loading per service
issues.acceptance: Missing env vars fail at startup with clear errors.

issues.summary: Create packages/logger with structured JSON logs
issues.acceptance: Logs include service, requestId, userId, route, durationMs, error.

issues.summary: Create packages/errors with shared error codes and HTTP mapping
issues.acceptance: All standard error codes defined and mapped to HTTP status.

issues.summary: Create packages/jwt with RS256 JWKS verification helper
issues.acceptance: Validates iss, aud, exp, signature via JWKS.

issues.summary: Create packages/contracts with shared DTOs and domain event types
issues.acceptance: DTOs for Auth, Users, Movies, Rooms, Notifications exported.

issues.summary: Create packages/testing with DB/Redis/Mongo cleanup helpers
issues.acceptance: Test helpers for HTTP, users, movies, cleanup available.

issues.summary: Add unit tests for config, errors, logger, JWT validation failures
issues.acceptance: pnpm test passes for all shared packages.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/gateway with health, readiness, metrics, shared error format
issues.acceptance: GET /health/live, /health/ready, /metrics work.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/auth-service with health, readiness, metrics
issues.acceptance: Health and metrics endpoints respond.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/users-service with health, readiness, metrics
issues.acceptance: Health and metrics endpoints respond.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/movie-service with health, readiness, metrics
issues.acceptance: Health and metrics endpoints respond.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/rooms-service with HTTP health + WS port placeholder
issues.acceptance: HTTP :4004 and WS :4014 ports configured.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/notifications-service with health, readiness, metrics
issues.acceptance: Health and metrics endpoints respond.

issues.summary: Scaffold apps/transcode-worker with health + queue consumer stub
issues.acceptance: Worker starts and exposes health endpoint.

issues.summary: Add Dockerfile for each app and wire all services into docker-compose.yml
issues.acceptance: All services build and start via docker compose.

issues.summary: Verify all service health endpoints on ports 4000-4005
issues.acceptance: curl health checks pass for all 6 HTTP services.
